summary: Re-tested /promote route after main agent added <Route path='/promote'> + currency formatting fix. Found and FIXED a runtime ReferenceError ('useCurrency is not defined') in PromoteEarn.js — the hook was used at line 25 but never imported. After adding `import { useCurrency } from './CurrencyContext';` (line 5), /promote now renders cleanly. ALL acceptance criteria pass: promote-earn-page mounts, QR <canvas> rendered, promoter-code=ISLA5A5D, 3 buttons (copy/download/share), promoter-paid=TT$0.00, promoter-held=TT$0.00, four reward-row-* entries in TT$ default (+TT$33.90 / +TT$169.50 / +TT$271.20 / +TT$271.20 corresponding to 5/25/40/40 USD via RATE_TTD_PER_USD=6.78), no-onboards and no-leaderboard empty-state markers present. Currency toggle via [data-testid='currency-option-USD'] correctly flips ALL amounts to US$5.00 / US$25.00 / US$40.00 / US$40.00 and persists 'USD' in localStorage; toggling back to TTD restores TT$ values. Regressions still pass: /join/ISLA5A5D landing renders (heading + 'You're invited by IslandHop Owner' text), Admin Panel Promoters tab opens with no runtime errors.
action_items: None blocking. Sanity recommendation: add a CI lint rule (no-undef ESLint) — the original useCurrency missing-import would have been caught statically. PromoteEarn.js had the same bug pattern slip past iteration 19.

Optional polish: PromoteEarn copy says 'reward straight to your IslandHop wallet' but rewards are simply '+TT$X' badges with no currency selector explanation; consider tooltip noting amounts follow navbar TT$/US$ toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED THIS RUN: /app/frontend/src/PromoteEarn.js was missing `import { useCurrency } from './CurrencyContext';` even though it called `const { format } = useCurrency();` on line 25. This caused an Uncaught ReferenceError that crashed the entire /promote page (empty body shell, no React tree mounted). Root cause: when main agent added the format() calls + Route registration, the import statement was not added. Added in this run.
PromoteEarn.js now properly formats all monetary values (rewards, paid total, held total, leaderboard entries) through useCurrency().format() — TT$ default and US$ toggle both verified live.

The CurrencySwitcher container has data-testid='currency-switcher' (a wrapper div), and individual buttons use data-testid='currency-option-TTD' / 'currency-option-USD'. Tests/automation should click the option testids, not the container.

rca of the issue: RCA for the 2nd-iteration bug discovered this run: In iteration_19 PromoteEarn.js used a hard-coded `+5 USD` style string; iteration 20 main agent refactored to `+{format(schedule[t] ?? 0)}` calling `const { format } = useCurrency()` on line 25 BUT forgot to add `import { useCurrency } from './CurrencyContext';` at the top of the file. At runtime, React called PromoteEarn() during the route mount → ReferenceError: useCurrency is not defined → ErrorBoundary swallowed render → page body sample showed only the bootstrap shell, no data-testids reachable. Reproduction: 1) login as owner, 2) navigate to /promote, 3) Dev overlay shows 'Uncaught runtime errors: useCurrency is not defined at PromoteEarn'. Mitigation applied: added `import { useCurrency } from './CurrencyContext';` as line 5 of PromoteEarn.js. Verified post-fix: /promote renders all expected testids, currency toggle flips reward values, regression flows still pass.
